newsitem.title: ITALY: Police uncover Italy-Venezuela mafia drug cartel.
newsitem.headline: Police uncover Italy-Venezuela mafia drug cartel.

text.p: Italian police said on Friday that 32 people had been arrested in Italy and Venezuela on suspicion of involvement in an organised crime drugs cartel operating between the two countries.
Police said they had been investigating members of the 'Ndrangheta mafia from the southern region of Calabria since 1995 in connection with the trafficking of drugs between Europe and South America.
The ring also produced narcotics for sale, police said.

Investigators said 22 arrests were made in Calabria by paramilitary police working closely with authorities in Caracas, who simultaneously arrested 10 suspects in Venezuela. Others suspected of having links to the ring were arrested in northern and central Italy.

Police said they seized some 100 million lire ($58,800) in cash and half a billion lire in precious goods. An unspecified quantity of Kuwaiti dinars, held by the 'Ndrangheta in Switzerland, was also discovered. ($=1,700 lire)
